evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Quinton establishes an operational rule setting a recurring schedule with 'from now on', performing an organizational decision.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Quinton frames unrehearsed capability as non-existent capability in an axiomatic, definitional rule that serves as an identity/bedrock principle.
